documentation.title: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II
Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II
documentation.role: Cross-check of the SPH storage input block

documentation.title: Installation Manual of SPH-UP series
documentation.role: Model identity, ports, and LCD measurement names

connection.notes: The SPH TL BL-UP manual documents RS485, not an Ethernet port. Use a Modbus RTU-to-TCP gateway. Protocol II V1.24 specifies 9600 bps, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit, unit id 1, and at least 850 ms between commands. This profile waits 1 second, the interval the protocol suggests.

registers.name: AC output energy today
registers.meaning: Energy accumulated today in the register labeled generate energy. On a hybrid inverter that label does not by itself prove the value is PV-only yield.

registers.name: AC output energy total

registers.name: Inverter run time

registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol V1.20, input registers 57-58, p. 34
registers.notes: Protocol II V1.24 lists the same address, width, and 0.5 s scale. The value is stored in seconds.

registers.name: Inverter temperature
registers.meaning: Inverter temperature.
registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II V1.24, input register 93, p. 50
registers.notes: The protocol preface says each register is an unsigned 16-bit integer, but a temperature can be negative and this input register does not document the offset code used by some limit settings. The decoder therefore uses signed int16. Positive temperatures are identical in both interpretations.

registers.name: Battery discharge power
registers.meaning: Magnitude of battery discharge power. Charge is reported in a separate register, not as a negative value.
registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II V1.24, input registers 1009-1010, p. 61

registers.name: Battery charge power
registers.meaning: Magnitude of battery charge power.
registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II V1.24, input registers 1011-1012, p. 61

registers.name: Battery voltage
registers.meaning: Battery terminal voltage. The SPH BL-UP manual describes a nominal 48 V battery system, which agrees with a 0.1 V scale.
registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II V1.24, input register 1013, p. 61

registers.name: Battery state of charge
registers.meaning: Battery state of charge reported by the inverter.
registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II V1.24, input register 1014, p. 61
registers.notes: The SPH manual LCD shows battery capacity as a percentage beside battery voltage. Values outside 0-100 are treated as unavailable.

registers.name: Grid import power
registers.meaning: Power flowing from the grid toward the premises. The register label is AC power to user.
registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II V1.24, input registers 1021-1022, p. 61
registers.notes: The SPH manual describes signed meter power as positive when it is to the user and negative when it is to the grid. Phase registers are omitted because this model is single-phase and the total register is the household figure.

registers.name: Grid export power
registers.meaning: Power flowing from the premises toward the grid.
registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II V1.24, input registers 1029-1030, p. 62
registers.notes: Paired with the import register. The manual's signed meter display uses the opposite sign for export.

registers.name: Inverter load power
registers.meaning: Power the inverter is delivering to its local load. This is not assumed to be the whole-house load measured by the meter.
registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II V1.24, input registers 1037-1038, p. 62

registers.name: Battery temperature
registers.meaning: Battery temperature for lead-acid or lithium, as labeled.
registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II V1.24, input register 1040, p. 62
registers.notes: The protocol preface says each register is an unsigned 16-bit integer, but a temperature can be negative and this input register does not document the offset code used by some limit settings. The decoder therefore uses signed int16. Positive temperatures are identical in both interpretations.

registers.name: Grid import energy today
registers.meaning: Energy taken from the grid today. The register label is energy to user today.
registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II V1.24, input registers 1044-1045, p. 62

registers.name: Grid import energy total
registers.meaning: Lifetime energy taken from the grid.
registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II V1.24, input registers 1046-1047, p. 62
registers.notes: The low register's description text repeats the word high. Its address and H/L name identify it as the low word.

registers.name: Grid export energy today

registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II V1.24, input registers 1048-1049, p. 62

registers.name: Grid export energy total
registers.meaning: Lifetime energy delivered to the grid.
registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II V1.24, input registers 1050-1051, p. 62

registers.name: Battery discharge energy today

registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II V1.24, input registers 1052-1053, p. 62

registers.name: Battery discharge energy total

registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II V1.24, input registers 1054-1055, p. 62

registers.name: Battery charge energy today

registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II V1.24, input registers 1056-1057, p. 62

registers.name: Battery charge energy total

registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II V1.24, input registers 1058-1059, p. 62

registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II V1.24, input registers 1060-1061, p. 63

registers.name: Inverter load energy total

registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II V1.24, input registers 1062-1063, p. 63

registers.name: EPS frequency
registers.meaning: Backup-output frequency. The table's example values 5000 and 6000 match 50.00 Hz and 60.00 Hz at 0.01 Hz per count.
registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II V1.24, input register 1067, p. 63

registers.name: EPS voltage
registers.meaning: Backup-output voltage. The table's example value 2300 matches 230.0 V at 0.1 V per count.
registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II V1.24, input register 1068, p. 63

registers.name: EPS current
registers.meaning: Backup-output current.
registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II V1.24, input register 1069, p. 63

registers.name: EPS apparent power
registers.meaning: Backup-output apparent power.
registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II V1.24, input registers 1070-1071, p. 63
registers.notes: The SPH manual LCD also shows EPS power in watts. This register's unit column is VA, so watts are not invented from it.

registers.name: EPS load
registers.meaning: Backup-output load as a percentage of the EPS rating.
registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II V1.24, input register 1080, p. 63

registers.name: Battery cycle count
registers.meaning: Charge and discharge cycle count reported by the battery management system.
registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol V1.20, input register 1095, p. 45
registers.notes: The SPH row does not print a unit. The same V1.20 document lists BMS_CycleCnt again at input register 3221 with a scale of 1. Protocol II V1.24 and V1.39 keep this name at input register 1095.

registers.name: Battery state of health
registers.meaning: Battery state of health reported by the battery management system.
registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol V1.20, input register 1096, p. 45
registers.notes: The SPH row does not print a unit or a percent scale. The same V1.20 document lists BMS_SOH again at input register 3222 with a scale of 1. Protocol II V1.24 and V1.39 keep this name at input register 1096.

registers.name: Highest cell temperature

The decoder therefore uses signed int16. Positive temperatures are identical in both interpretations.

registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II V1.24, input register 1115, p. 64
registers.notes: The protocol preface says each register is an unsigned 16-bit integer, but a temperature can be negative and this input register does not document the offset code used by some limit settings. registers.name: Parallel highest state of charge

registers.name: Firmware version
registers.meaning: Firmware version text stored in three ASCII registers.
registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II V1.24, holding registers 9-11, pp. 10-11

registers.name: Serial number
registers.meaning: Inverter serial number, ten ASCII characters across five registers.
registers.source: Growatt Inverter Modbus RTU Protocol II V1.24, holding registers 23-27, p. 12
registers.notes: The SPH manual LCD shows a ten-character serial number, which matches the five-register width.
